name: Colorado

law.name: Uniform Athlete Agents Act (C.R.S. 23-16-201 and following), registration repealed in 2010; agent contract rules (23-16-104); NIL law (23-16-301)

covers_nil_agents: Yes for the contract and notice rules. An agency contract covers endorsement deals (C.R.S. 23-16-202). No state registration. Only a licensed attorney may give legal representation (23-16-301(4)).
summary: No state license. Follow the contract, warning and school-notice rules, and only attorneys may give legal advice.

steps.detail: Colorado repealed agent registration in 2010. A 2019 bill to bring it back was vetoed.

steps.text: Register with each school's compliance office, if it asks
steps.detail: Most schools have their own agent sign-up.

steps.text: Use a written contract with all required items
steps.detail: Your pay and how it's figured, any other pay you get, anyone else being paid, expenses, services, length, date signed and every guarantee you make.

steps.text: Put both required warnings next to their signature
steps.detail: The Warning to Student Athlete box in bold capitals, plus Colorado's second warning about blank spaces and guarantees. The exact words are below.

steps.text: Give the athlete a copy when they sign
Tell the athletic director in writing within 72 hours of signing
steps.detail: Or before the athlete's next game, if that comes first. This is your duty, on top of the athlete's.

steps.text: Make sure the athlete tells the athletic director within 72 hours
steps.detail: Or before their next game, if that comes first. The athlete must tell the athletic director about every paid NIL deal, following the school's process.

steps.text: Let the athlete cancel within 14 days
steps.detail: They cancel by written notice. They owe you nothing and keep anything you gave them to sign.

steps.text: Date the contract the day it's signed
steps.detail: Federal law (SPARTA) bans pre-dating or post-dating it.

steps.text: Only a licensed attorney may give the athlete legal advice
steps.detail: Anyone giving a college athlete legal representation must be a licensed attorney.
Names and addresses of clients, every contract and what you spent recruiting each athlete.

steps.text: Never give gifts or money to recruit athletes or make false promises
steps.detail: Don't give anything of value before they sign, or to anyone but the athlete or another agent. Never pre-date or post-date a contract.

watch_list.item: Federal Protect College Sports Act of 2026 (S.4668)
watch_list.status: Passed the Senate on Sept 28, 2026. The House is out until Nov 9 and leaders say it won't pass as-is. It dies if not enacted by Jan 3, 2027.
watch_list.impact: It would require every NIL agent to register in a state, cap agent fees at 5% of an endorsement deal and limit contracts to the athlete's eligibility.

review_notes: Statute text was read on colorado.public.law (2024 C.R.S.), not the official Colorado code. Confirm on leg.colorado.gov before launch.
The repeal of registration (C.R.S. 23-16-204 to 23-16-208) was confirmed only from secondary sites and the 2019 veto. Confirm the 2010 repeal bill on leg.colorado.gov.
Part 1 (C.R.S. 23-16-104) applies to athletes at Colorado colleges. Confirm with a lawyer that its second warning applies to NIL-only contracts.
contract_warning: Warning to student athlete. If you sign this contract: (1) you may lose your eligibility to compete as a student athlete in your sport; (2) if you have an athletic director, within 72 hours after entering into this contract, both you and your athlete agent must notify your athletic director; and (3) you may cancel this contract within 14 days after signing it. Cancellation of this contract may not reinstate your eligibility. Also add this second warning (C.R.S. 23-16-104): Warning to student athlete: Do not sign this contract until you have read it or if it contains blank spaces. Do not sign this contract if it does not specify all of the guarantees made to you by the athlete agent. If you decide that you do not wish to purchase the services of the athlete agent, you may cancel this contract by notifying the athlete agent in writing of your desire to cancel the contract within fourteen days after the date on which you sign this contract.
